biotools.summary: pathlinkR is an R package designed to streamline RNA-Seq data analysis by facilitating pathway enrichment and network-based analyses. It provides tools for pathway enrichment, network plotting, and visualization, aiding in the interpretation of results and enabling users to efficiently extract biological meaning from large datasets.
